Sheet 21 shows proposed behind-the-curb improvements along Collier Street including 'PROPOSED ADA PATH' with hatching pattern and 'PROPOSED VARIABLE WIDTH PUBLIC SIDEWALK EASEMENT' with sidewalk spot elevations (SW 551.30, SW 549.70, etc.). Behind-the-curb improvements include sidewalks, ramps, landscape strips, trees, lighting, and work between curb and property line. The grading plans focus primarily on topographic data rather than comprehensive behind-the-curb infrastructure.

findings.resolution: Add or clarify existing and proposed behind-the-curb improvements (sidewalks, curbs, ramps, street trees, lighting) on the grading plan for all street frontages including South Lamar Boulevard, Kinney Avenue, and Collier Street. Distinguish existing from proposed elements.

findings.observation: Reviewed project README, facts.md, and conducted semantic search for 'new roadway construction road building street pavement plan profile'. The search returned only standard detail sheets (Sheets 30-31 showing generic street cross-sections), utility plan/profile views for water and wastewater lines (Sheets 19-20), erosion control details, and on-site paving details. No plan and profile views for new public roadway construction were found. The facts.md indicates ROW dedication along Collier Street and Kinney Avenue for behind-the-curb improvements (sidewalks, ADA paths), but no new roadway construction. The Overall Site & Paving & Striping Plan (Sheet 13) shows on-site circulation and parking, not new public roadway construction.
findings.reasoning: The condition for this item is 'If new roadway construction proposed'. Based on comprehensive review, the project involves site redevelopment with ROW dedications for sidewalks and behind-the-curb improvements, but does not propose construction of a new public roadway requiring horizontal and vertical alignment drawings. The paving work shown is for on-site areas, driveways, parking, and sidewalk connections, not new roadway construction. Therefore, this checklist item is not applicable.
findings.explanation: No new roadway construction is proposed; project includes ROW dedications for sidewalks and behind-the-curb improvements only.

findings.observation: As documented in CC-23-05 analysis, no new roadway construction is proposed for this project. Semantic search and review of the plan set found no roadway plan/profile views or target speed notations. The project involves site redevelopment with behind-the-curb improvements (sidewalks, ADA paths) and on-site circulation, but no new public roadway construction requiring design speed specifications.
findings.reasoning: The condition for this item is 'If new roadway construction proposed'. Since no new roadway construction is proposed (see CC-23-05), the requirement to note target speed for a new roadway does not apply. Target speed per TCM is required for new or modified roadways to drive geometry, sight-distance, and signage/striping requirements, but is not applicable when only sidewalk and behind-the-curb improvements are being constructed.
findings.explanation: No new roadway construction proposed; target speed requirement not applicable.

findings.observation: Reviewed Sheet 13 (Overall Site & Paving & Striping Plan) using vision tool. The sheet shows striping for parallel parking stalls along Collier Street within the ROW, crosswalk striping at driveway entrances, and paving patterns. Vision analysis confirmed that striping IS shown for the parallel parking modifications in the Collier Street ROW, but signage (such as parking regulation signs, stop signs, or other traffic control devices) is NOT explicitly shown on this sheet. The condition 'If new roadway construction or work in ROW' is met because parallel parking striping in Collier Street ROW constitutes work in ROW modifying the roadway.
findings.reasoning: The checklist item requires 'Signage and striping plan' for new or modified roadway in ROW. The project proposes parallel parking striping in the Collier Street ROW, which is a roadway modification. Sheet 13 provides the striping plan (parking stall striping, crosswalk markings) but does not show a signage plan (parking regulation signs, etc.). The deficiency text states 'Signage AND striping plan not provided' - the conjunction 'and' indicates both are required. Since signage is not shown, this constitutes a partial failure of the requirement.
findings.explanation: Striping plan is shown for parallel parking in Collier Street ROW, but signage plan for the modified roadway is not shown.
findings.resolution: Add signage plan showing parking regulation signs and any other required traffic control signage for the parallel parking modifications along Collier Street.
